text:
deploy-bot: ✅ Deploy started — environment: sandbox • tag: rc5 • commit: 9f2a7e3 • initiated by @alex

alex: starting canary rollout, 3/20 pods in canary group. smoke tests queued. pin strategy: if canary ok, pin rc5 to sandbox for further QA.

deploy-bot: canary group deployed to node-pool-sbx-c1 (3 replicas). k8s rollout id: rollout-1934567001

ops-bot: quick heads-up — monitoring alerts on svc-inference spike threshold set at 150ms P95. will watch.

sam: seeing ~8% 500s on one canary pod, repeating request: 
```
ERROR inference.kvcache: missing-shard for key 0x4c1a
Traceback: ...
```

judy: hm, that kvcache error looked flaky in yesterday's stress run. can we try restarting just that pod and re-run smoke?

alex: yes. putting canary on hold. will restart failing pod and re-run smoke. not rolling back yet.

deploy-bot: Canary status: HOLD by alex — reason: 2/3 canary pods showing transient 500s. automated rollback NOT triggered.

maria: restarting pod inference-canary-2 now (kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference --pod inference-canary-2). re-running smoke suite after restart. ETA ~ 3m.

sam: logs after restart look cleaner, 500s gone, latency P95 down to 92ms on canary. still want a second smoke run to be safe.

judy: agreed. if second run stays green, recommend pinning rc5 to sandbox for QA and not promoting to devtest yet. also add a note to release-diff: possible kvcache shard edge-case.

deploy-bot: Smoke run #2: PASS. All canary pods healthy. Canary metrics: errors 0.9% (baseline 0.7%), P95 95ms.

alex: decision: pin rc5 to sandbox for QA, but do NOT promote to devtest until we ship a kvcache mitigation. I've added a ticket: INF-4286. tagging commit in release notes.

deploy-bot: Version pinned in sandbox: rc5 (9f2a7e3) — pin TTL: manual. Rollout paused from sandbox->devtest.

ops-bot: I've updated the deploy dashboard and added an annotation on the rollout: "canary hold -> pin to sandbox for QA; follow INF-4286".

sam: creating short blurb for release-notes: "Sandbox: rc5 (9f2a7e3) rolled to canary, pinned for QA after transient kvcache errors observed and mitigated; follow-up INF-4286."

alex: thanks team. reopening in ~24h for final decision. if anything regresses we will rollback to rc4 (tag rc4-8b3c1f). :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy thread closed for now — status: PINNED to sandbox • rc5 • started: 1934567001 • updated: 1934567042
